name: Do I need permits for a sliding door threshold replacement in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a sliding door threshold replacement in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, a straightforward sliding door threshold replacement that does not involve structural changes to the door frame or opening typically does not require a permit in Daly City or other Bay Area cities. However, if the project expands to include significant alterations to the wall, framing, or resizing the door opening, then a permit may be necessary. It's always advisable to consult with your contractor or the local building department to confirm permit requirements for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Generally, permits are not needed for simple threshold replacements in Daly City, but may be required for structural alterations. Consult your contractor.
